DLR_2006_p56__paragraph_3.ocr:
The tax treatment of dividends on common stock paid in 2006 is estimated as follows: approximately 74%
ordinary income and 26% return of capital. The tax treatment of dividends on common stock paid in 2005 is as
follows: approximately 87% ordinary income and 13% return of capital. All dividends paid on our preferred
stock in 2006 and 2005 were classified as ordinary income for income tax purposes.
